title: START AT with one value skips the rows that sort before it
query: EVALUATE VALUES ( Player[Score] ) ORDER BY Player[Score] START AT 80

source.quote: It defines the value at which the query results begin.
source.supports: the result begins at the value

derivation: Distinct scores ascending: 50, 70, 80, 90. Starting at 80 leaves 80 and 90.
